text: Exceptional service, care in detail and went above and beyond with some last minute additions. Absolutely recommend them 5++++. And polite, nice guys as well. Thank you.

author: Izzy W.
text: I had such an incredible experience with Small Movers Canada, and want to make sure that they get the recognition they deserve! I was deeply impressed by the speed and professionalism in how they communicated, in both email correspondence and during the move itself. Shout out to Mark and Nick in Victoria for being friendly, flexible, and efficient at what they do. Small Movers Canada will be my go to company in the future, and the one I champion for when others need a recommendation.
